title: Physical Interpretation of Elliptic Partition Functions
exact_target: Test whether elliptic-cohomology string partition functions arise by compactifying a twelve-dimensional F-theory, using the proposed loop-index calculations.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30000244 (OWR-832-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Geometric Topology and Connections with Quantum Field Theory (2005), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2005/27, pp. 1505--1546; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF page 11.
Kriz--Sati Type II modularity; reference in the saved dated catalogue literature review.

status_qualification: The twelve-dimensional physical theory and its loop indices are proposed constructions. The report does not supply a fully axiomatized F-theory partition function with all backgrounds fixed; the target is an interpretation and its proposed tests, not an already defined equality for every conceivable background.
